notes.title: New Update to Ashes Cricket now available
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

A new update to Ashes Cricket is now available.

The patch notes for this update are as follows:

- Added Human Edge Frequency Slider.
- Added Timing Window Adjustment Slider.
- Fixed issue with misfields playing dropped catch commentary.
- Tuned edge rate online. 
- Resolved issue that could occur in online co-op matches.
- Tuned AI chasing in limited over matches.
- Improved stability.

Thanks everyone for their feedback and suggestions.

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Update now available
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

A new update to Ashes Cricket is now available.

The patch notes for this update are as follows:

Fix issue with display of custom stadiums in tour designer.
Fix issue with host team in World Championships if team has custom home grounds.
Fix for lineups being auto generated for Tour/Competition mode instead of using user chosen/academy line up.
Academy: Fixed issue preventing adding players to teams in some cases.
Online: Custom logos will be maintained after resuming save.
Added reset academy options.
Added HUD enable/disable option to settings menu.
Added option to have a real bowler as well as bowling machine for nets/ground training.
Enabled more cameras in nets/ground training.
Adjustments to AI batting and bowling.
Tuned stamina/confidence.
Tuned fielding, including wicketkeeper reactions and increased dropped catches.
Tuned ducking movement.
Performance improvements.
Stability and other general improvements.

Thanks everyone for their feedback and suggestions.

Enjoy!

notes.title: New patch now available
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A new update has now gone live for Ashes Cricket. The patch notes are as follows:

Features -
Added Look Down option while batting (press LT+RT while batting and move Right Stick)
Added option to hide score HUD
Added two new outfield grass pattern options
Added licensed Australian Domestic teams
Added "Enforce Classic Controls" option for Online matches

AI -
Tuned AI innings pacing, run rates
Tuned AI running between wickets
Tuned AI field selection
Adjusted AI bowling line and lengths
Increased impact of player mentalities on performance
General AI improvements

Gameplay -
Tuned seam movement
Adjusted impact of skills and attributes on player performance
Adjusted batting timing
Adjusted impact of pitch conditions
Allowed player to appeal on no-balls
Tuned bowling speeds in Women's Cricket
Increased Hard and Hardest difficulty settings

General Adjustments -
Modified ball colours to make them more visible
Adjusted pitch visuals
Improvements to commentary
Bowling speed readings will display independent of bowling speed slider settings
Score HUD will now update after each ball

Fixes -
Fixed issues with local co-op inverted batting controls and camera selection
Fixed issue where batsman would remain at their crease after a wicket
Fixed crash attempting to skip to player while viewing the field in career
Fixed crash selecting delivery type
Fixed issue where simulation warning message would remain on screen in career
Fixed issue where day-night test matches would not cycle to daytime at the start of new days
Fixed issue with follow on enforcement
General Stability Improvements

---

Thanks everyone for your feedback and for playing!
